notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
